{
  "analysis": "The training data reveals that German legal texts frequently use specific academic and professional titles (Dr., Mag., Univ.-Prof., etc.) and role anchors (Richter, Beschwerdeführer, vertreten durch) to identify persons. Capitalization alone is insufficient due to German noun capitalization rules. The rules focus on these high-precision anchors to extract names while avoiding false positives from legal terms and organizations.",
  "strategy": "Implement 5 distinct regex rules targeting specific title patterns, role-based contexts, and salutations to ensure high precision in identifying person names within German legal documents.",
  "note": "Every rule includes output_template and output_key. Patterns use capture groups for names to allow context matching without including the context in the final entity text.",
  "rules": [
    {
      "name": "academic_titles",
      "description": "Matches names preceded by academic titles like Dr., Mag., Univ.-Prof., Priv.-Doz., etc.",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?:Dr\\.|Mag\\.|Univ\\.-Prof\\.|Univ\\.-Prof\\.in|Priv\\.-Doz\\.|Priv\\.-Doz\\.in|Hon\\.-Prof\\.|Hon\\.-Prof\\.in|OMedR|OStR|Ri|StR|RgR|KommR|MedR|Techn|R|PhD|Bakk\\.\\s*(?:iur|phil|rer\\.nat|art)|LL\\.M\\.|LLB|M\\.B\\.L\\.)(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+)*(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+)*)",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 10,
      "reasoning": "Academic and professional titles are strong indicators of person names in legal texts. This pattern captures the title and the full name following it."
    },
    {
      "name": "role_context_richter",
      "description": "Matches names following role descriptions like 'Richter', 'Richterin', 'Senatsvorsitzender', etc.",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?:der\\s+Richter|die\\s+Richterin|der\\s+Senatsvorsitzende|der\\s+Senatsvorsitzende|die\\s+Senatsvorsitzende|der\\s+Beisitzer|die\\s+Beisitzerin|der\\s+Vorsitzende|die\\s+Vorsitzende)\\s+(?:[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+)*)(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+)*)",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 9,
      "reasoning": "Role descriptions like 'Richter' or 'Senatsvorsitzender' are followed by the judge's name. This rule captures the role and the name to ensure context."
    },
    {
      "name": "role_context_beschwerdefuehrer",
      "description": "Matches names following 'Beschwerdeführer', 'Antragsteller', 'Bf.', etc.",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?:der\\s+Beschwerdeführer|die\\s+Beschwerdeführerin|der\\s+Antragsteller|die\\s+Antragstellerin|der\\s+Bf\\.?|die\\s+Bf\\.?)(?:\\s+(?:[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+)*)(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+)*)|(?:[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+)*)(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+)*)\\s*[,)]?)",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 8,
      "reasoning": "Parties in legal proceedings are often referred to by their role (Beschwerdeführer, Antragsteller) followed by their name. This rule captures the role and name."
    },
    {
      "name": "salutation_herr_frau",
      "description": "Matches names following salutations like 'Herr', 'Frau', 'Herrn', 'Frau' (accusative/dative).",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?:Herrn?\\.?|Frau\\.?)(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+)*)",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 7,
      "reasoning": "'Herr' and 'Frau' are common salutations followed by a person's name. This rule captures the salutation and the name."
    },
    {
      "name": "represented_by",
      "description": "Matches names following 'vertreten durch' (represented by).",
      "format": "regex",
      "pattern": "(?:vertreten\\s+durch)\\s+(?:[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+)*)(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+(?:\\s+[A-ZÄÖÜ][a-zäöüß]+)*)",
      "output_template": {
        "text": "$0",
        "start": "$start",
        "end": "$end",
        "type": "person"
      },
      "output_key": "entities",
      "priority": 6,
      "reasoning": "'Vertreten durch' is a standard phrase introducing a representative's name. This rule captures the phrase and the name."
    }
  ],
  "deleted_rules": []
}
